name: Fuji Seal International, Inc.
summary: Fuji Seal International, Inc. engages in planning, proposal, development, manufacturing, and sales of packaging systems. The company offers shrink sleeve labels for containers; pressure sensitive labels used in promotional and advertising campaign tools; spouted pouches; rotary machines, linear machines, hybrid steam tunnels, self-adhesive/pressure-sensitive labelers, and PSL labeling systems; and packaging services, as well as training and maintenance services, after-service support services, and remote service centers.
